query:
SELECT b.id, b.mentorId, mp.id as mentorProfileId, mp.userId, u.name
FROM bookings b
JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON b.mentorId = mp.id
JOIN users u ON mp.userId = u.id
WHERE u.name = '이윤호'
LIMIT 5;
